title: Mixed Event — My Color! — Episode3 Imperfect Perfection

meta.Event Outline: The MORE MORE JUMP! livestream kicks off to a great start! Things are going smoothly, until Shizuku's fear becomes a reality. Shizuku must reevaluate her past and present self in order to arrive at her ultimate decision.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's just focus on practicing our singing and dancing like normal, while responding to comments as we go for today's stream.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As long as we sort of stick to the plan, we're basically free to just do as we like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, don't be so tense. We're supposed to be showing everyone how we usually are, so try to relax a little.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You've been acting a little off lately...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Are you worried about being able to maintain the image you had from back when you were in Cheerful*Days?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes...
A little...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Your fans tend to be more passionate than most, right? I remember even hearing a lot of girls scream, I love you, Shizuku! during your shows.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you're you, Shizuku. As long as you work as hard as you always do, I'm sure the fans will cheer you on.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And if anything does happen, I'm here for you. So let's just do our best, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. Thank you, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She's right. This is only the first of many livestreams. I just need to do my best.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Good afternoon!
Thank you for joining us again today!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Haruka!>
<She's here!>
<So cute as usual!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Today, we'd like to show you a bit of our everyday routine!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's right. First off, we'd like to show you what a typical dance practice looks like for us!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I wanna see your dance practice!>
<I can't wait!>
<Good luck!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! We'll give it our best!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Who's that again?>
<Oh, I forgot about her.>
<Give us more Shizuku...!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Urgh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to give it my all. I can't afford to mess up...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Airi, you're a bit fast!
And Minori, you're about one beat behind!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Next, I move to the center and turn...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku, that was a great turn!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, thank goodness...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Well done, everyone.
We're starting to sync up nicely.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Shizuku was on her game today too.
Pure perfection!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<That's because Shizuku's a great dancer!>
<Nah, she's good at everything!>
<Shizukuuu!!!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: See? Everyone else thinks so too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's take a quick break before we do some singing practice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Great idea!
I'm parched...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Phew... Where'd I put that water...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hm... Waaah!
I dropped it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm fine. But I just spilled all my water...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Is the newbie a klutz?>
<Haha! That was pretty funny!>
<Airi, give her some of yours.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sure, take some of...
Oh, I already drank it all...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Would you like some of mine?
I still have about half in my thermos.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Shizuku's so nice...>
<Lucky! I want some of Shizuku's water!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Make sure to drink it while it's still warm.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
While it's still warm...?
Did you bring tea today?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, it's miso soup.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, what?! Miso soup?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Miso soup right after practice? You're joking, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sure, why not? It's nice and filling after a hard workout. Plus, it even helps warm you up after you get chilly from sweating so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I suppose that makes sense, but I think I'll stick with water or a sports drink after practicing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's so like you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hahaha. It sure is!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hm? Look at the comments...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Was Shizuku always like this?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: *Gasp*...!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She's different from what I imagined.>
<Is she going for a new image?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku tends to get cold easily, so she usually prefers warm drinks! Isn't that right...?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<That's actually kind of interesting.>
<That's not the Shizuku I want to see.>
<She always seemed more refined, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Stop arguing in the comments.>
<Miso soup? This has to be scripted lmao.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What do we do? The comments just keep coming...!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <This isn't Shizuku.>

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: I say we go with this as your image. It'll be a great selling point...

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Got it? When you're on TV, all you have to do is smile. You can leave the talking to the other members up on stage.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: You're sure to get more fans this way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was being so careful...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But in the end, I can't be perfect...
